title: Name the force and its source
target: Identify forces on a chosen object and name each interaction partner.
criteria: Name the chosen object and each force source.
Distinguish mass from weight with units.
Include only forces acting on the chosen object.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: For a hanging lantern, what interaction supplies the upward force?
options: The cord pulls on the lantern.
The lantern pulls on the cord.
The Earth pulls upward on the lantern.
cpa.guide: Name the source and recipient; the cord exerts tension on the lantern.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: For a book resting on a table, what supplies the upward normal force?
options: The book pushes on the table.
The table pushes on the book.
cpa.guide: The normal force is the table’s contact force on the book.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A 6 kg package is where g = 10 N/kg. What are its mass and weight?
cpa.guide: Mass is 6 kg; weight = mg = 60 N.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A label says a sample’s mass is 4 N. What is wrong?
options: Newtons measure force; mass should use kilograms or another mass unit.
Four is too small to be a mass.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: Which force belongs on the free-body diagram of a bag hanging from a rope?
options: A velocity arrow counted as a force.
The bag’s force on the rope.
The rope’s force on the bag.
cpa.guide: Only forces acting on the chosen bag belong on its diagram.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A lamp rests on a desk with no cord attached. Which proposed force should be removed from its diagram?
options: The desk’s support force, also called the normal force.
cpa.guide: Without a cord or similar pulling connection there is no tension interaction.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
